title: Change the details of a blasting explosive user licence
summary: Use an amendment form to add classes or change approvals on your blasting explosive user licence.
intro: If you want to add classes or change the approvals on your blasting explosive user licence, you’ll need to lodge an amendment form. There is no fee associated with this request.
what_you_need: The PDF form: ‘Amendment to a blasting explosive user licence – Application’

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application by email (preferred) or post to the details on the form.
